schema.description: Custom contrastive evaluation set for separating harm-recognition from refusal behavior. Each prompt is a stimulus; the model's actual response and 'refused' label are recorded at extraction time. The 'educational' category is intentionally paired by 'topic' with a 'harmful' prompt so that topic and refusal-expectation are decorrelated.

fields.prompt: the user request text sent to the model
fields.category: one of: harmful | harmless | educational | dual_use
fields.topic: underlying subject, used to pair harmful/educational prompts
fields.expected_harmful: bool: is the REQUEST genuinely asking for harmful assistance
fields.expected_refusal: bool (nullable): design-time hypothesis of whether a well-aligned model SHOULD refuse. null for dual_use (ambiguous).
